postgame.what_decided_it: Cincinnati moved the ball and still lost. 437 yards, 26 first downs, but 23 rushing yards on 15 carries, 2-of-4 in the red zone, two Burrow picks and 11 penalties for 108 yards. Jacksonville turned it over zero times.
standouts: Tee Higgins: 11 catches, 157 yards. Carried the passing game with no touchdown to show for it.
Joe Burrow: 39/54, 428 yards, 1 TD, 2 INT, plus a 6-yard rushing score on three carries.
Trevor Lawrence: 18/23, 227 yards, 1 TD, no picks. Clean game, and ESPN notes it is his first win over the Bengals.
postgame.division_meaning: Cincinnati sits last in the AFC North at 2-2 on an L2, behind Cleveland (3-1, W3) and Baltimore (3-1, W2) and level with Pittsburgh (2-2, L1). Point differential is still a plus-12.
postgame.the_take: A 428-yard passing day that produces 17 points is a run game problem, not a Burrow problem. Until 1.5 yards a carry changes, every red zone trip is a coin flip. ESPN also flags a receiver health question.
